reasoning:
**Question.** Resolves Yes if, by 28 Nov 2026 (Paraguay time), the Banco Central del Paraguay (BCP), its intervention team or the deposit guarantee fund (FGD) has publicly named a specific calendar day on which FGD payments to holders of ueno bank CDAs begin or began. A subset of holders is enough.

**Starting point.** Taken at face value (no CDA payment yet, date still to come), a regulator naming an exact day within ten days is roughly a 30-35% event. On 16 Nov FGD director José Maciel said there was still no precise date for the next disbursement (La Nación), and on 17 Nov the BCP board extended the deadline to honour the guarantee to 2 Dec (Resolution 14; ABC Color and Última Hora, 18 Nov).

**Evidence that moved me.**
- The record suggests the criteria were met before the question opened. At its 11 Nov press conference the BCP (board member Pedro Acosta) said guarantee payments for electronic CDAs were available from that day, Wednesday 11 November, while funds for physical CDAs were transferred but blocked pending title checks (Agenda Legal, 11 Nov).
- The BCP's own release of 11 Nov says it made the disbursement to the last groups "este miércoles" and that CDA holders receive the credits subject to verification. Its 12 Nov release says the release of advances to CDA holders "continúa en curso".
- On 17 Nov Maciel said the retained CDA funds would be freed gradually over the coming days, with no date (La Nación).

**What gives No.** The resolver treats blocked or pre-opening payments as not counting and wants a fresh dated announcement, and the BCP gives none before 28 Nov, for example because the second-stage payment (up to 75 minimum wages) is only scheduled close to the 2 Dec deadline.

**Weighing.** About 55-60% that the 11 Nov statements are accepted as a stated start day, plus roughly a 30% chance of a new dated statement otherwise.

**Forecast: 68%.**
question_title: Will the Banco Central del Paraguay announce a payment start date for ueno bank CDA holders by 28 November 2026?
